mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_schedules (job_id, schedule_date, start_time, end_time, schedule_name, slots_available, contact_name, contact_phone, status, total_items, external_batch_id) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{scheduleName}, #{slotsAvailable}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{totalItems}, #{externalBatchId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM job_schedules WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY schedule_date ASC, start_time ASC
SELECT * FROM job_schedules WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY schedule_date ASC, start_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE job_schedules SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE job_schedules SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.sql: FROM job_schedules js JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT schedule_id, COUNT(*) application_count, SUM(status = 'PENDING') pending_count, SUM(status = 'ACCEPTED') accepted_count, SUM(status = 'REJECTED') rejected_count FROM schedule_applications GROUP BY schedule_id ) app ON app.schedule_id = js.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.job_id, ss.shift_date, ss.start_time, ss.end_time, COUNT(*) shift_count, SUM(ss.status IN ('ABSENT','LATE','EARLY_LEAVE','LATE_EARLY_LEAVE')) exception_count, SUM(ar.settlement_status = 'SETTLED') settled_count, SUM(ac.status = 'PENDING') correction_pending_count FROM schedule_shifts ss LEFT JOIN attendance_records ar ON ar.shift_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN attendance_corrections ac ON ac.shift_id = ss.id GROUP BY ss.job_id, ss.shift_date, ss.start_time, ss.end_time ) sh ON sh.job_id = js.job_id AND sh.shift_date = js.schedule_date AND sh.start_time = js.start_time AND sh.end_time = js.end_time WHERE j.company_id = #{companyId} AND js.job_id = #{jobId} AND (j.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR js.schedule_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND js.status = #{status} AND js.schedule_date >= #{startDate} AND js.schedule_date <= #{endDate}
mapper.select:
SELECT js.id, js.job_id, j.title job_title, COALESCE(js.schedule_name, j.title) schedule_name, js.schedule_date, js.start_time, js.end_time, COALESCE(j.address, j.location) location, js.contact_name, js.contact_phone, js.slots_available, COALESCE(app.application_count, 0) application_count, COALESCE(app.pending_count, 0) pending_count, COALESCE(app.accepted_count, 0) accepted_count, COALESCE(app.rejected_count, 0) rejected_count, GREATEST(COALESCE(js.slots_available, 0) - COALESCE(app.accepted_count, 0), 0) remaining_slots, COALESCE(sh.shift_count, 0) shift_count, COALESCE(sh.exception_count, 0) exception_count, COALESCE(sh.settled_count, 0) settled_count, COALESCE(sh.correction_pending_count, 0) correction_pending_count, js.status, js.total_items, js.external_batch_id, js.created_at
ORDER BY js.schedule_date DESC, js.start_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT sa.id application_id, sa.worker_id, w.name worker_name, w.phone worker_phone, CASE WHEN wr.status = 'APPROVED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END real_named, sa.status application_status, sa.applied_at, ss.id shift_id, ss.status shift_status, ar.check_in_time, ar.check_out_time, ar.status attendance_status, ar.settlement_status, ac.status correction_status FROM ( SELECT id FROM schedule_applications WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY applied_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset} ) filtered JOIN schedule_applications sa ON sa.id = filtered.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON w.id = sa.worker_id LEFT JOIN worker_real_name_auth wr ON wr.worker_id = sa.worker_id LEFT JOIN schedule_shifts ss ON ss.application_id = sa.id LEFT JOIN attendance_records ar ON ar.shift_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN attendance_corrections ac ON ac.shift_id = ss.id ORDER BY sa.applied_at DESC, ss.id ASC
